content_sections.heading: About ESIC

This engagement is for ESIC Medical College and Hospital at K.K. Nagar, Chennai-78, an IS/ISO 9001-2015 certified institution according to the notice.

rows.pay_honorarium: Rs. 6,000 per day (Director Professor/Professor); Rs. 4,000 per day (Associate Professor)

content_sections.heading: ESIC Adjunct Faculty Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Not exceeding 67 years on the date of the walk-in interview (11 November 2026). A postgraduate degree as prescribed, or a recognized qualification equivalent thereto, in the department of Radiodiagnosis. Eight years of work experience in the concerned specialty after obtaining the PG degree. The candidate must be registered with the State Medical Council/NMC, as applicable, before joining. Research publications are not mandatory for faculty retired, resigned or voluntarily retired from Government or other medical colleges when re-engaged on the same designation. The application form asks for the age as on the date of interview and whether experience is recognised by MCI/DCI. For the full eligibility details of each post, check the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Scope of Work
content_sections.text: Teaching responsibilities, with at least four sessions a month, each lasting not less than 3 hours. Sessions may be theory, small group discussions, practicals, community-based sessions, clinical/bed-side teaching, or radiological imaging, diagnosis and reporting. Visiting faculty will not do routine administrative work of the department and will not replace full-time faculty. The medical college will collect feedback on their teaching every six months.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Document verification: candidates report with the filled application form. Only those whose documents are verified can attend the interview. Interview: selection depends on performance in the interview before the Selection Board. Professor and Associate Professor candidates face a combined interview. Offer: issued on the recommendation of the selection committee, considering the functional requirements. The result will be sent by e-mail and displayed on the website. Selected candidates must join immediately after receiving the offer of engagement.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Purely contractual engagement for one year, which the Dean may extend for another year based on performance and feedback. The engagement may end for unsatisfactory work or misconduct; gross misconduct or negligence leads to termination without notice or payment in lieu of notice. No right or preference for regular engagement. No claim to PF, pension, gratuity, medical allowances, medical benefits, seniority or promotion. Absence of fifteen days without permission counts as voluntary abandonment and automatic termination. Attendance must be marked manually and on the Aadhar Enabled Bio-metric Attendance System (AEBAS) every scheduled working day. No TA/DA for the interview or for joining.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ESIC Adjunct Faculty Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Download the official notification and print the application form on pages 5 to 9. Fill in the form: post and specialty, demand draft particulars, personal details, e-mail (mandatory), Aadhar number, category, qualifications, employment history, research publications (excluding case reports and review articles), training and academic achievements. Affix a self-attested recent passport size photograph and sign the declaration, including the line that a No Objection Certificate from the present employer has been obtained. Report at ESIC Medical College and Hospital, K.K. Nagar, Chennai on 11 November 2026 between 2.00 PM and 4.00 PM for document verification, with the filled form. Wear a face mask, carry sanitizer and maintain social distance, as the notice instructs. Applications in any other format, or incomplete applications, will be rejected. Any change in the interview date will be announced only on the website. Two copies of a recent self-attested passport size photograph. Self-attested copies of certificates for proof of age (date of birth), educational qualification, experience, and research papers and publications. The originals of the same certificates. For queries, contact the office of the Dean, ESIC Medical College and Hospital, Ashok Pillar Road, K.K. Nagar, Chennai on 044-24748959 (10.00 AM to 4.00 PM Monday to Friday, 10.00 AM to 1.00 PM Saturday), or e-mail [email protected] along with your contact number.

faq.question: Q1. How many Adjunct Faculty posts are there at ESIC Medical College, K.K. Nagar?
faq.answer: The notice proposes to engage 3 Adjunct (Visiting) Faculty in Radiodiagnosis, at the Professor and Associate Professor levels.

faq.question: Q2. When and at what time is the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: On 11 November 2026. Candidates must report between 2.00 PM and 4.00 PM; anyone reporting after the scheduled time will not be allowed into the interview.

faq.question: Q3. What is the honorarium for Visiting Faculty?
faq.answer: Director Professor/Professor get Rs. 6,000 per day and Associate Professors get Rs. 4,000 per day.

faq.question: Q4. How many teaching sessions must Visiting Faculty take?
faq.answer: At least four sessions a month, each of not less than 3 hours.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be older than 67 years on the date of the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q6. How much experience is required?
faq.answer: Eight years of work experience in the concerned specialty after obtaining the PG degree.

faq.question: Q7. How long is the contract?
faq.answer: One year, which the Dean can extend for another year based on performance and feedback.

faq.question: Q8. Is medical council registration needed?
faq.answer: Yes. The candidate must be registered with the State Medical Council/NMC, as applicable, before joining.

faq.question: Q9. Will travel allowance be paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA is admissible for the interview or for joining.

faq.question: Q10. How will the result be announced?
faq.answer: The result will be sent by e-mail and displayed on the website, and selected candidates must join immediately after receiving the offer.
